title: Spring Egg Rolls with Russian Twist
description: A creative take on traditional spring egg rolls, this recipe incorporates a rich and creamy Russian-inspired sauce, making it a delicious gluten-free option.

ingredients.name: Spring roll filling (shredded vegetables, meat, etc.)

instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
2. Prepare the spring roll filling according to your preference.
3. Lay an egg roll wrapper on a clean surface with one corner pointing towards you.
4. Place about 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of the wrapper.
5. Brush the edges of the wrapper with water.
6. Fold the bottom corner of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
7. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
8. When the oil is hot, add a few of the egg rolls to the pan (do not overcrowd).
9. Fry the egg rolls until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
10. Remove the egg rolls from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
11. Serve the egg rolls hot with Russian sauce for dipping.
